text:
Situation: Alteplase 2.2 mg/2 mL vials are not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Genentech, Inc. posted a "To Be Discontinued" status for Alteplase Injection 100 mg vial (NDC 50242-085-27) with an initial posting date of 2026-05-21. Current inventory is 191 vials (20.4 days) at Corvale East and 298 vials (28.6 days) at Corvale General.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show the 100 mg vial (NDC 50242-085-27) is marked "To Be Discontinued" as of 2026-05-21. The 2.2 mg/2 mL presentation (NDC 50242004110) is manufactured at FEI 3006129086 (last known inspection 2018-01-16, VAI) and FEI 3007232634 (last inspection end 2024-04-19, VAI). A Class II recall (D-0509-2024) for Cathflo Activase 2 mg vials was initiated 2024-05-20 and terminated for deformed stoppers.

Our position: Supply of the 2.2 mg/2 mL presentation is finite and not replenished by the manufacturer for the discontinued 100 mg vial NDC. No shortage is declared by FDA for this NDC. Inventory covers approximately three to four weeks at current burn rates.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to contact Genentech for allocation status and expected final shipments for NDC 50242004110; requires Director of Pharmacy approval.
2. Buyer to identify and qualify alternative alteplase presentations or manufacturers; requires P&T Committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to implement allocation protocol between Corvale East and General based on utilization parity; requires Director of Pharmacy approval.
4. Buyer to report weekly inventory burn rate to P&T Committee until stable supply confirmed; requires P&T Chair acknowledgment.

Not recommended: Initiating therapeutic substitutions or protocol changes without P&T clinical review.
